Generated Narrative: CodeSystem eu-ai-data-quality-cs

This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-data-quality-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
representative RepresentativeThe data are assessed as sufficiently representative of the relevant population, setting, or intended use.
error-free Error-ControlledThe data were subject to measures intended to identify, reduce, and manage errors.
complete CompleteThe data are assessed as sufficiently complete for the documented purpose.
relevant RelevantThe data are assessed as relevant to the documented purpose and intended use.

name: EUAIDataQualityCodeSystem
title: EU AI Data Quality Code System
description: Codes describing assessed data-quality characteristics relevant to the development, validation, testing, or evaluation of an AI system.
